## Personality

Howard is a highly educated man who possesses a strong need for conversation. Because listeners are scarce in his surroundings, he eagerly seeks out opportunities to talk to anyone willing to listen.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021)_

## History

Howard was originally a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) who once did a kindness for Captain Jim. As a result of that past favor, Captain Jim later sought to return the goodwill by helping him.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P22](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0022)_
